project_type: Python/FastAPI backend + React/TypeScript/Vite frontend + AWS CDK infra, agentic V-cycle for automotive OEMs
build_system: pip + venv for backend (root .venv), Vite for frontend (frontend/), CDK v2 Python for infra (infra/)
verification_instructions: 1) Set F2F_LLM=offline and F2F_DEMO_PACE=0.0 before running tests. 2) Run .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q backend/tests/ from repo root. 3) For CDK: cd infra && .venv/bin/python app.py (synths without AWS creds). 4) For frontend types: cd frontend && npx tsc --noEmit.
snapshot_or_generated_files: infra/cdk.out/ is generated by cdk synth (infra/.venv/bin/python app.py); not committed. frontend/dist is generated by npm run build; not committed.
environment_constraints: All backend tests must run offline (F2F_LLM=offline). Never fake connector output — simulated mode must be labelled. CDK synth works without AWS credentials. The Lambda functions use lambda_.Function (not DockerImageFunction) with Code.from_asset. The infra/lambda/ directory does NOT exist yet and must be created.
contribution_requirements: Every stage handler reports only through StageContext (ctx.log, ctx.artifact, ctx.link, ctx.set, ctx.thought, ctx.tool). Connectors follow the protocol in base.py: info: ConnectorInfo attribute + capability method. Unconfigured connectors run in simulated mode and set info.status='simulated'. Stage evidence must be ASPICE/UNECE R156 suitable (StageRun: summary, reasoning, artifacts, links).
key_patterns: 1) Connector pattern: two classes (live + simulated) + factory function, see backend/app/connectors/ota.py. 2) Stage handler pattern: function taking StageContext, uses ctx.thought/log/tool/artifact/link/set, see backend/app/agents/stages.py detect() and triage(). 3) Registry pattern: list of (ConnectorInfo, [stage_keys]) tuples in registry.py catalog(). 4) CDK pattern: lambda_.Function with Code.from_asset for pure-Python Lambdas; DockerImageFunction for the main app. 5) Frontend Badge tones: ok=emerald, run=blue pulse, warn=amber, bad=red, neutral=slate. 6) Frontend tabular numerals: use className='tnum' (CSS class defined in project, maps to font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums).
directory_structure: backend/app/ — FastAPI app, models, config, llm, connectors/, agents/, pipeline/; backend/tests/ — pytest tests; infra/ — CDK stack (app.py), Dockerfile.lambda; infra/lambda/ — NEW: Lambda handlers go here; data/ — seed/fixture data; frontend/src/ — React app, components/, pages/, lib/
